reason: Stale premise. The finding says exp89t (K + DIS 2.25 + CI) was 'never built' and is 'not proposed', with action 'None'. CONTEXT 08:23Z (l.4415-4425) and commit 096d533 (08:23:08Z) show exp89t BUILT (experiments/exp89t_k2cap6_k_dis225_ci/probe.json: exp87a knobs + ILP_DISAPPEARANCE_WEIGHT 2.25). Its dummy was pushed at 08:22:49Z. It is slotted as slot 1 (the cancelled A-M1), submit ~09:05Z on the user's yes. So 'action None' conflicts with the live plan. The finding's timing (send 09:15Z, read 18:33-18:44Z) also differs from the logged 09:05Z send and 18:25-18:35Z typical read. Only the external-null part holds: e10 20260929T0813Z DIFF shows no change in any kernel list or status, just 13 LB histogram moves. The finding misses the real issue with exp89t, which is consistency. A-M2 rule (a) (08:19Z) sends the non-CI DIS sibling exp89s only if exp89r >= 0.958. Sending exp89t at ~09:05Z puts DIS on the LB before exp89r reads (submitted 00:05Z, CI L 9.27-9.48 h, so ~09:21-09:34Z). That means DIS goes out with zero LB evidence, and DIS has only lab and indirect support, the same pattern as the edge filter (+0.016 local, 0 on LB). It also breaks the logged 08:45Z CI cutoff by ~20 min, and a 10.9 h tail would land after the 20:00Z tick.
fix: Replace R36H-3 with a reads-vs-card note on exp89t. (1) Record exp89t as built, dummy pushed 08:22:49Z, pending the user's yes. (2) Tell the user that sending at 09:05Z is ungated on DIS, while exp89s is gated on exp89r >= 0.958. Offer a choice: (a) send at dummy PASS (typical read ~18:25-18:35Z, tail after 20:00Z), marked 'DIS ungated'; or (b) wait for exp89r's first terminal header (~09:21-09:34Z) and send only if exp89r >= 0.958 under the same rule (a). Option (b) reads typically ~18:40-19:05Z, and a 10.2-10.9 h tail misses the tick, so it can only count as a final if it reads by 20:00Z. (3) Keep the gate pre-registered before exp89r reads. (4) The external-null statement stands.
realistic_gain: Unknown and likely small: +0.001 at best on public (it becomes V_pub only at >= 0.960 vs exp87a 0.959). DIS has no LB read yet, and the private effect cannot be verified. The main value of this correction is procedural: it keeps an ungated DIS slot from going out unnoticed and keeps the log accurate.
